summary: Phase 11 full verification — Integrations Health Strip, AgencyHandy HMAC, OG PNG, /admin/clients UI, /admin/approvals UI + Approval Studio loop. Backend: 12/12 phase11 + 21/21 phase10 regression all PASS. Frontend: all 6 health pills render on dashboard, OpenRouter pill turns green after /test fire, sidebar nav links present, /admin/clients renders with testclient row + search + refresh + resend, /admin/approvals dialog uploads design (mock mode) and surfaces mock-log dialog, client portal login + 5 tabs all visible.
action_items: Test IDs in upload dialog (upload-client-email-input, upload-project-name-input, upload-asset-name-input, upload-design-url-input, upload-submit-button) differ from review-request-stated names (admin-approvals-*). No functional bug — just doc discrepancy. Consider aligning either the spec or the testids for consistency with other admin-* prefix conventions.
critical_code_review_comments: Approval Studio upload flow correctly bumps version on re-upload via (client_email, asset_name) tuple match — verified by test_aps_re_upload_bumps_version.

Health strip query uses /admin/integrations/health which aggregates last ping across all 6 providers — pill colour driven by status field (green/yellow/red), consistent with backend _record_ping shape.
AgencyHandy HMAC: when no AH_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var is set, behaviour is correctly fail-open with verified=false but ok=true (so AH won't retry). x-ah-sig=test header trusted path verified.

ApprovalsAdmin upload dialog form has inputs without surrounding <form> element and no client-side validation for required fields — backend still validates, but consider adding HTML5 required/pattern for better UX.
OG PNG: cairosvg render produces 67.8 KB at 1200x630 — well within social-card guidelines.
test_credentials: Admin founder@thesalvador.group / admin123 and client testclient@bybloomlabs.com / clientpass123 — both work.
seed_data_creation: Test only created mock-mode approvals (test_aps_*@example.com + 'UI Test Project A'). Mock-mode entries persist in DB but are harmless seed-style records used by future regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11 is fully shipped and verified. The Approval Studio is intentionally in MOCK mode (APPROVAL_STUDIO_USERNAME/PASSWORD not set) — surfaced via aps_mode=mock in upload response and via /admin/approvals/mock-log endpoint. Nifty PM token still empty — design approvals correctly skip Nifty comment sync (nifty_synced.comment=false). Pass REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before running pytest as the test file reads os.environ[REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL] without a default. If you need to verify HMAC live verification (verified=true with non-test sig), set AH_WEBHOOK_SECRET in /app/backend/.env first.

frontend_verification_details.admin_approvals_upload_flow: Dialog opens, form fills (testids: upload-client-email-input, upload-project-name-input, upload-asset-name-input, upload-design-url-input, upload-submit-button), submit shows toast 'Uploaded · Approval Studio link copied', new row appears in list

curl_verification.ah_webhook_no_sig: ok=true verified=false (correct fail-open behaviour, no AH_WEBHOOK_SECRET set)
